title: Look Up a Group
body:
The Look Up a Group feature enables you to search for specific Medical Groups by specialty within a defined geographic area. Search results include details for each provider within the group, making it easier to explore and compare available Medical Groups. This module is designed to help users identify Medical Groups (not individual providers) with certain specialties in a specific region. ## Accessing Look up a Group Look up a Group can be accessed from the left-hand sidebar navigation panel by clicking on **Broker Tools** or **Recruitment & Research** and then selecting the **Look up a Group** option.

Search Criteria

 ### Group Name or ID To find a group of providers, you need to enter at least one of the following pieces of information without using any wildcard symbols: * full or partial group name * TIN * Group ID **Note:** A name such as, “Smith” can be entered into the Group Name or ID field and medical groups that contain the name “Smith” will be returned in the results. Individual providers (physicians) are not returned in search results. **Group Name or ID Field Functionality** When using the **Group Name or ID** field, you can begin by entering characters into the field. Groups that match the entered characters will be displayed in a drop-down list. Clicking on a name from the drop-down list will take you directly to that **Group Profile** page. Clicking on **Go**, or enter key, without a selection from the drop-down list will display a list of group names that match the criteria in the **Search Results** page and clicking on any of the Group Names will display the **Group Profile** page. The Results section shows each of these pages. ### Provider Specialties Optionally, select **PROVIDER TYPES** or **SPECIALTY GROUPS**. This is a multi-select field, meaning you can select more than one option from the dropdown list. Selecting provider types and/or specialties helps refine your search by displaying providers affiliated with the chosen specialties within that group. ### Within Optionally, enter a geography. You can enter cities, counties, MSAs, state abbreviation, a population file, or zip codes (3-digit or 5-digit codes). You can also run a bulk zip code search. * Entering partial zip codes or free form text will not yield any results. * Using the create a population file option, enables you to create a new file to be used in your search. * When you enter multiple geographies, Network360 uses “or” logic, so if you enter 'Johnson County, KS' and 'Topeka, KS MSA' you will see providers that reside in either geography. For more details on Bulk Search, see the [Bulk Search](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/bulk-search) help content. For more details on creating a Population File, see the [Population File](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/population-file) help content.
![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-landing-page.png)

Results

 Depending on the method used in the **Group Name or ID** field, the results are displayed in two following ways: **Scenario 1:** Enter your search criteria within **Group Name or ID**. Click on **Go**, or press the enter key, without a selection from the drop-down list. A list of Group Names with TIN number in parentheses is displayed in **Search Results** page. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-groupname_id.png) Clicking on a Group Name from the list displays the **Group Profile** page with cards for each provider within the group. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-groupprofilepage_randomname.png) **Scenario 2:** Enter your search criteria within the **Group Name or ID** field and select a Group Name from the dropdown list and click **Go**. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-groupnamefromlist.png) The **Group Profile** page displays with cards for each provider within the group. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-groupprofilepage_fromselection.png) For more details on Group Profile page, see the [Group Profile](/#!/help/sections/using-network360/sections/group-profile) help content.

Exporting the Provider Details List

 The Provider Details List can be exported as a CSV file for external use. To initiate the export, click the **Export** button. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-export.png) When the export process begins, a notification will appear confirming that the export has started. Once the export is ready to be downloaded, an additional message will be displayed with a summary of your search criteria and a link to **Download results**, as shown in the screenshot below. ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-export-initiation.png) If you click the dropdown arrow within the **Export** button, you can select which columns you want to include in your export, such as Networks (when you choose networks you can then select either summary or specialty details), Tags, Provider Comments, and/or Custom Attributes (if applicable). ![](/cms/cms-assets/media/look-up-a-group-export-provider-profile.png) When you select Networks with Summary, your export will include a Network column for each provider-location in the Provider Profile page and the specialty will be the best match from all the networks. When you select Networks with Specialty Details, your export will include all provider-location-specialty combinations, rather than only the best match specialty. When you select Networks with either Summary or Specialty Details, Par Indicator (Participating Indicator) codes are included in the Network column(s) for each provider-location-specialty combination in the export file.
